description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_RomanNumerals', which preprocesses numeric data to format it as Roman numerals. It includes functionality to convert integers to Roman numeral strings using the Numbers_Roman utility, and it extends a data preprocessor class within the image graph rendering library.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_RomanNumerals
classes.description: A class that converts numeric data to Roman numeral strings for data preprocessing in graph rendering.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RomanNumerals data preprocessor and includes the necessary Numbers_Roman utility.
